description: Mistral AI's 4.4B multilingual realtime speech-to-text model on one DGX Spark, served by vLLM 0.32.0 as the vLLM Voxtral Realtime recipe documents (`--tokenizer-mode mistral`, piecewise CUDA graphs, 131,072-token window, about three hours of audio). vLLM mounts the OpenAI transcription route, POST /v1/audio/transcriptions, which the Vonk API facts and smoke use, and also the streaming WebSocket route /v1/realtime for live audio; the Realtime route is not yet a typed Vonk interface. 13 languages, any transcription delay from 80 ms to 2.4 s set in the model's tekken.json (480 ms default). Uploads are limited by vLLM's defaults of 25 MiB and 600 seconds. Memory uses 0.8 of the engine, the fraction the sibling vLLM speech recipes declare (the creator sets none, and vLLM's default of 0.9 would declare more than a Spark offers), and is an estimate until tried.
title: Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime 2602 (vLLM, single Spark)
